briefTitle: A Phase I/IIa Study of AZD8205 Given Alone or Combined, in Participants With Advanced/Metastatic Solid Malignancies

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Measurable disease per RECIST v1.1
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease per RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment, not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Life expectancy ≥ 12 weeks
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Life expectancy is a subjective clinical judgment, not a typed lab or stage check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Adequate bone marrow, hepatic, and renal function as defined in the protocol
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Broad organ function statement without specific numeric cutoffs in this section.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Relapsed/metastatic solid tumors treated with prior adequate standard of care therapy for tumor type and stage of disease or where in the opinion of the Investigator, a clinical trial is the best option for the next treatment based on response and/or tolerability to prior therapy.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Investigator opinion and general prior therapy without explicit typed prior lines or drug constraints.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Squamous Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Trial enrolls multiple solid tumor types across different sub-studies with varying inclusion criteria, making a single histology_in check incomplete without sub-study context.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Nitrosourea or mitomycin C within 6 weeks prior to the first dose of study treatment
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Complex washout window for specific therapies.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Any investigational agents or study drugs from a previous clinical study within 5 half-lives or 28 days (whichever is shorter) prior to the first dose of study treatment
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Complex washout window involving half-lives.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Any other anticancer treatment within the following time periods prior to the first dose of study intervention: Cytotoxic treatment: 21 days; Non-cytotoxic drugs: 21 days or 5 half-lives (whichever is shorter); Biological products including immuno-oncology agents: 28 days
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Complex conditional washout windows.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Spinal cord compression or a history of leptomeningeal carcinomatosis.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Not a clean brain_mets status check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Active infection including tuberculosis and HBV, HCV or HIV
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Infection exclusion criteria are not part of the allowed typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: History of (non-infectious) ILD/pneumonitis that required steroids, has current ILD/pneumonitis, or where suspected ILD/pneumonitis cannot be ruled out by imaging at screening.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Pulmonary history and imaging judgment criteria.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants with any of the following cardiac criteria...
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Complex multi-part cardiac exclusion criteria.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Brain metastases unless treated, asymptomatic, stable, and not requiring continuous corticosteroids at a dose of > 10 mg prednisone/day or equivalent for at least 4 weeks prior to start of study.
